technique_name: Compare and contrast the views of Thomas Hobbes and Jean-Jacques Rousseau on government.
description: Thomas Hobbes and Jean-Jacques Rousseau both believed that government is necessary for society’s stability, but they had different views on the purpose of government and its role in society. Hobbes believed that government should be strong and absolute so that it could protect its citizens from harm.
